title: Owner exports a fresh full-site ZIP after email verification
steps: S1: Request a fresh site backup, pack the export, verify the emailed code, and download the ZIP.
expect: S1: only an Owner can start the export; fresh backup includes the large-file snapshot; EmDash and Joomla packages include platform instructions; an email code is required before a link is issued; BACKUP_EXPORT=off closes the doors.
evidence: Postgres-backed route tests plus host package tests cover the complete export boundary and package contents.
fence: One-click fresh backup, Owner-only export, code-gated link issue, platform package contents, and export kill switch.

tests: export: an Owner gets 202 at once, the host packs and uploads, and the status door hands a fresh download link
export: an editor and a viewer are refused, on both doors; the host is never asked
export: a code older than ten minutes cannot issue a download link
export: a fresh backup can be packed with the same-lock large-file snapshot enabled
BACKUP_EXPORT off: both doors answer 404 EXPORT_OFF before anything is filed, /backups says may.export false, the sweep still runs
export-package: EmDash includes app, database, uploads and its Node-host README
export-package: Joomla package has move instructions and the four database placeholders
export with include-large: files over 50 MiB captured with the fresh backup are included and scope says so
